subject: general
question: {If } a - b = 9 { and } ab = 20, { find the value of } a² + b².
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Using the direct algebraic identity: a² + b² = (a − b)² + 2ab Substitute the given values directly into the formula. a² + b² = 9² + 2 × 20 a² + b² = 81 + 40 = 121 **∴ The correct answer is 121.**
